name: SinPurge
short: Purge recent messages from a specific user.
description: SIN Corporation moderation tool for deleting recent messages from one user in the current channel or across all text channels.
install_msg: SIN Purge installed. Use `[p]sinpurge @user 1h` or `/sinpurge` if slash commands are enabled and synced.
